title: Prove paid return of every physical head for the clean six-tape multiplier
body:
One fixed finite six-tape program now multiplies every valid pair, returns the exact padded MSB product, leaves all five other tapes globally blank, genuinely halts, and physically returns every head to zero within 280n² + 282n + 71 transitions. Width zero is included. The new four-state scanner takes exactly 4n + 2 transitions and preserves every cell; the intervening scheduler handoff is also charged.

The product word clocks one accumulator move per bit and one operand-head move per pair. A real reverse scan returns the output head. No unbounded control register, coordinate relabeling or free head reset is used. Applications include minimal-width natural operands, ZMod/signed residue labels, and embedding in arbitrary finite banks with dirty spectator heads/cell functions preserved at every prefix. The supplied two-stack input ABI remains explicit; operands are consumed, and signed parsing or physical truncation is not asserted.

Validation: four new modules and aggregator received fresh kernel checks; 58 unchanged dependency modules were reused only under exact prior fresh source/artifact/import/toolchain/revision guards. A fresh complete transitive-axiom audit covers 4,896 declarations and 2,512 theorems; only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound are allowed. Four real Lean ownership/axiom fixtures, the unchanged frozen-root check, and 1,425 literal operational controls passed. Public replay.py supports a full cold source rebuild; no full cold rebuild of the 58 reused modules is claimed for this local run. External Mathlib binaries are supplied pinned cache artifacts, not independently rebuilt. Hosted CI and human review are not claimed.

This extends PR2775 and the retained arithmetic/compiler/parking lineage. Current actual-source review credits Dan Brown and Kenny Daniel's complete finite-TM2 asymptotic multiplication linked by PR2411, its existing paid-return routines, and PR2769 bank restoration. The contribution is this concrete simultaneous six-head endpoint and charge, not first multiplication, first return scan, a new exponent or selected kappa. No platypii source is copied or imported. Original source licenses/notices remain.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one root plus three parallel agents. Open next questions: charged serialized/signed parsing, actual marking/buffer placement into reusable callers, and variable-depth recursion/routing.
